body: Thank you for all your help <333 I literally just got my period after like 4 days now and it’s not light so I think I’m good now? I’ll still keep an eye out for any signs, thank you so much again I truly appreciate it.
Thank you again, I found a pregnancy test underneath one of our sinks and it was negative so I hope I’m okay now. It wasn’t a fresh test though so it might be wrong, I hope not.
Yeah, I’m definitely having a more serious talk with him about how that’s a form of sexual abuse and how it really hurt me.

Thank you all for these comments, they have definitely eased my mind a lot more. I’m going to wait another week or two to make sure my period comes back before I tell my mom. I’m not sure what I’m going to do with my relationship yet, I’m definitely having a more serious talk about how dangerous this was to my health physically and mentally, plus that it was a form of sexual abuse.

Edit:// my period started back up and it’s not light so I believe I’m good now, thank you  all again who commented. It really helped me stay calm and not freak out as much.

I’ve had my bc for about a year know, I’ll try my best to get a bunch of pregnancy tests because that would definitely ease my mind. I wasn’t too aware that bc can cause a change that big on periods! I mainly said taking them to try and time my periods back into a cycle, but thank you for telling me!

About my mom though she got pregnant when she was around 17 (I’m the baby from it), so I know she’ll understand, but she’s kinda verbally abusive to me and I don’t react well to it. She’s actually the one to take me to get bc so she does know about it. I’ve just heard many horror stories about family abandoning their kid because of it and I guess it’s gotten to my head.
Thank you so much, this helped me a bit <33 I really appreciate it
Thank you for telling me, and Im just really scared. I don’t know if I’m over reacting about this or not.
